offence.name: Sacrificial Dagger — Psychic attacks +1 to Hit, +1 to Wound
offence.desc: Once per phase, when this model shoots or fights: its unit suffers 1 mortal wound, and until the end of the phase its Psychic attacks have +1 to hit and +1 to wound.

offence.name: Ascended Daemon (re-roll one Hit + one Wound) — Daemon Prince
offence.desc: Each time this model shoots or fights, re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound roll - modelled as a single re-roll of the worst hit and the worst wound.

offence.name: Prey on the Weak - re-roll Hits of 1 (vs Battle-shocked / Below Half-strength)
offence.desc: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY units re-roll Hit rolls of 1 against a target that is Battle-shocked or at/below Half-strength. Toggle when the target meets either condition.

offence.name: Rain of Ruin - ranged [HEAVY]
offence.desc: Ranged attacks have [HEAVY]: +1 to Hit if the unit Remained Stationary (set the Stationary condition).

offence.name: Pass Dark Pact
offence.desc: Gate. Pick one flavor below.

offence.name: Lethal Hits
offence.desc: Crit hits auto-wound.

offence.name: Sustained Hits 1
offence.desc: Each crit hit generates 1 extra hit.

offence.name: Daemonforge
offence.desc: Re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

offence.name: Mark of Nurgle: ranged crit on 5+
offence.desc: Sustained 1 also triggers on natural 5s for ranged attacks.

offence.name: Mark of Slaanesh: melee crit on 5+
offence.desc: Melee variant.

offence.name: Mark of Khorne: melee crit on 5+
offence.desc: Lethal Hits also triggers on natural 5s for melee.

offence.name: Mark of Tzeentch: ranged crit on 5+
offence.desc: Ranged variant.

offence.name: Mark of Chaos Undivided: re-roll Hits of 1
offence.desc: On a Dark Pact, Chaos Undivided units re-roll Hit rolls of 1 — applies regardless of the Lethal/Sustained pick.

offence.name: Within 6" of Vashtorr (Unholy Mechanisms)
offence.desc: +2 Strength to all weapons.

offence.name: Abaddon — Paragon of Hatred (re-roll Hits)
offence.desc: Pick this Warmaster ability in your Command phase.

offence.name: Despoilers (re-roll Hits on Dark Pact)
offence.desc: On Dark Pact: re-roll all Hit rolls. Chaos Terminator Squad.

offence.name: Veterans of the Long War (re-roll melee Wounds of 1)
offence.desc: Always-on: re-roll melee Wound rolls of 1. Check the child toggle when the target is on an objective for the full re-roll.

offence.name: Veterans of the Long War — target on an objective (full re-roll)
offence.desc: When the target is within range of an objective marker: re-roll ALL melee Wound rolls (replaces the re-roll-1s).

offence.name: Bringers of Change (re-roll ranged Wounds of 1)
offence.desc: Always-on: re-roll ranged Wound rolls of 1. Check the child toggle when the target is on an objective you don't control for the full re-roll.

offence.name: Bringers of Change — target on an objective you don't control (full re-roll)
offence.desc: When the target is within range of an objective marker you do NOT control: re-roll ALL ranged Wound rolls (replaces the re-roll-1s).

offence.name: Daemonic Ordnance (ranged Devastating Wounds)
offence.desc: Until end of Shooting phase, ranged weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] (and [HAZARDOUS]). Forgefiend.

offence.name: Unholy Bloodshed (Devastating Wounds, 1/battle on Dark Pact)
offence.desc: Once per battle on Dark Pact: weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]. Possessed.

offence.name: Within 6" of Helbrute (Dark Ascension)
offence.desc: Dark Pact grants BOTH [LETHAL HITS] AND [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (not one or the other). With this on, you can toggle Lethal AND Sustained simultaneously.

offence.name: Dark Apostle aura: Dark Zealotry (+1 melee Wound)
offence.desc: While Dark Apostle is leading this unit: +1 to melee Wound rolls.

offence.name: Fabius Bile aura: Enhanced Warriors (+1 S melee)
offence.desc: Bodyguard models' melee weapons gain +1 S. Only offered for the unit Fabius Bile is attached to.

offence.name: Focus of Hatred — re-roll Hit (vs your focus target)
offence.desc: Re-roll the Hit roll vs the enemy unit you mark as your focus of hatred each Command phase. Toggle when firing/fighting it.

offence.name: Raiders and Reavers — +1 AP (ranged, target near objective)
offence.desc: Ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] and +1 AP vs a unit within range of an objective marker. Toggle when the target holds/contests an objective.

offence.name: Debt to the Soul Forge — DAEMON VEHICLE +1 Wound (ranged)
offence.desc: On a Dark Pact, a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE gets +1 to Wound on ranged attacks. Toggle when invoking the contract.

offence.name: Debt to the Soul Forge — DAEMON VEHICLE +2 Attacks (melee)
offence.desc: On the same Dark Pact contract, +2 Attacks to its melee weapons.

offence.name: Experimental Augmentations
offence.desc: Pick one Augmentation below (or two if rolled randomly).

offence.name: Augmentation: Cholinergic Accelerants (+1 Attack melee)
offence.desc: INFANTRY +1 Attack to melee weapons.

offence.name: Augmentation: Paraneural Reactions (+1 WS = +1 Hit melee)
offence.desc: INFANTRY +1 Weapon Skill (= +1 to Hit in melee).

offence.name: Augmentation: Macrotensile Sinews (+1 Strength melee)
offence.desc: INFANTRY +1 Strength to melee weapons.

offence.name: Augmentation: Ophthalmic Enhancement (+1 BS = +1 Hit ranged)
offence.desc: INFANTRY +1 Ballistic Skill (= +1 to Hit at range).

offence.name: Specimens for the Spider (re-roll Wound vs CHARACTER)
offence.desc: 2CP — each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, re-roll the Wound roll.

offence.name: Empyric Wellspring: PSYKER +1 Strength ranged (Dark Pact)
offence.desc: When a HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit (excluding DAEMONS) makes a Dark Pact as it is selected to shoot: +1 Strength to its ranged attacks.

offence.name: Empyric Wellspring: DAEMON PRINCE +2 S, +1 AP melee (Dark Pact)
offence.desc: When a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE (not KHORNE) makes a Dark Pact as it is selected to fight: +2 Strength and +1 AP to its melee attacks.

offence.name: Terror Made Manifest — +1 Hit (vs Below Half-strength)
offence.desc: +1 to Hit vs a target that is Below Half-strength. Toggle when the target qualifies.

offence.name: Terror Made Manifest — +1 Wound (vs Battle-shocked)
offence.desc: +1 to Wound vs a Battle-shocked target. Toggle when the target is Battle-shocked.

offence.name: Tyrannical Motivation: Huron's Elite (+1 Hit)
offence.desc: INFANTRY units get +1 to Hit (the Huron's Elite ability; both abilities if visible to Huron Blackheart).

offence.name: Slaves to None: Vendetta — re-roll Hit (vs Vendetta target)
offence.desc: Re-roll the Hit roll vs your Vendetta target (marked each Command phase). Toggle when firing/fighting it.

defence.name: Surgeon Acolyte - one attack a turn has its Damage changed to 0 (while Fabius Bile lives)
defence.desc: Once per turn, when an attack is allocated to a model in this unit, if this unit contains Fabius Bile, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

defence.name: Prey on the Weak - attacker -1 to Hit (attacker Battle-shocked / Below Half-strength)
defence.desc: While the attacking unit is Battle-shocked or at/below Half-strength, each of its attacks targeting this HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit is -1 to Hit. Toggle when the attacker meets either condition.

defence.name: Iron Fortitude — −1 to be wounded (ranged, S>T)
defence.desc: Ranged attacks vs a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excl. DAMNED) whose Strength exceeds its Toughness are −1 to Wound (always on).

defence.name: Augmentation: Supracutaneous Chitination (+1 Toughness)
defence.desc: INFANTRY +1 Toughness. Pick one Augmentation (or two if rolled randomly).

defence.name: Soul Forge Boons — 5+ invulnerable (SOUL FORGE units)
defence.desc: HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE (gaining SOUL FORGE), LORD DISCORDANT and VASHTORR have a 5+ invulnerable save.

offence.name: Order: Take Aim! (+1 Ballistic Skill)
offence.desc: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to this unit’s Ballistic Skill characteristic. Issued to a REGIMENT (or SQUADRON via Squadron Command) unit by an Officer. A characteristic change, so it stacks with a +1 to Hit modifier rather than being capped against it.

offence.name: Order: First Rank Fire! Second Rank Fire! (+1 Attack, Rapid Fire weapons)
offence.desc: RAPID FIRE weapons add 1 to their Attacks characteristic (even when not within Rapid Fire range). INFANTRY REGIMENT only — vehicles cannot receive this Order. Applied only to this unit’s Rapid Fire weapons (lasguns / autoguns); non-Rapid Fire special & heavy weapons are unaffected.

offence.name: Order: Fix Bayonets! (+1 Weapon Skill)
offence.desc: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to this unit’s Weapon Skill characteristic. Issued to a REGIMENT (or SQUADRON via Squadron Command) unit by an Officer. A characteristic change, so it stacks with a +1 to Hit modifier rather than being capped against it.

offence.name: Grim Demeanour: Below Starting Strength (+1 Hit) — Death Korps
offence.desc: +1 Hit while unit is below Starting Strength. Pick one of these two state toggles.

offence.name: Grim Demeanour: Below Half-strength (+1 Hit, +1 Wound) — Death Korps
offence.desc: +1 Hit + +1 Wound while unit is Below Half-strength.

offence.name: Rearm, Reload, Fire ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] heavy) — Field Ordnance Battery
offence.desc: Heavy weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] when affected by an Order and unit Remained Stationary. Toggle when modelling that scenario.

offence.name: Flak Battery (re-roll Hit vs FLY) — Hydra
offence.desc: Re-roll Hit vs targets that can FLY.

offence.name: Armoured Spearhead (re-roll Hit of 1) — Leman Russ Battle Tank
offence.desc: Re-roll Hit of 1. Check the child toggle when the target is on an objective you don't control for the full re-roll.

offence.name: Armoured Spearhead — target on an objective you don't control (full re-roll)
offence.desc: When the target is within range of an objective marker you do NOT control: re-roll ALL Hit rolls (replaces the re-roll-1s).

offence.name: Tank-killer (vanquisher: re-roll Wound vs Monster/Vehicle) — Leman Russ Vanquisher
offence.desc: Vanquisher battle cannon re-rolls Wound vs Monster/Vehicle targets. Applies to all ranged in the engine — main gun dominates damage; sponsons get a small spurious boost.

offence.name: Mow Down the Enemy (punisher: Devastating Wounds) — Leman Russ Punisher
offence.desc: Punisher gatling cannon gains [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] vs non-Monster/Vehicle. Applies to all ranged — sponsons get a small spurious boost.

offence.name: Gung-ho Executioners (executioner: +1 Hit vs Below Half) — Leman Russ Executioner
offence.desc: Executioner plasma cannon gains +1 Hit vs Below Half-strength targets. Toggle when modelling that case.

offence.name: Titan-killer (volcano: Devastating Wounds vs Monster/Vehicle) — Shadowsword
offence.desc: Volcano cannon gains [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] vs Monster/Vehicle. Applies to all ranged — main gun dominates.

offence.name: Tempestor Prime ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] ranged) — Militarum Tempestus Command Squad
offence.desc: Passive while unit contains a Tempestor Prime. Stacks with Orders.

offence.name: Point-blank Barrage (+1 AP vs closest target) — Ogryn Squad
offence.desc: +1 AP on ranged attacks vs the closest eligible target. Toggle when modelling that scenario.

offence.name: Storm Troopers (re-roll Wound of 1) — Tempestus Scions
offence.desc: Re-roll Wound of 1. Check the child toggle when the target is on an objective marker for the full re-roll.

offence.name: Storm Troopers — target on an objective (full re-roll)
offence.desc: When the target is within range of an objective marker: re-roll ALL Wound rolls (replaces the re-roll-1s).

offence.name: Jungle Fighters (+1 Wound melee after Charge) — Catachan Jungle Fighters
offence.desc: +1 Wound on melee attacks if unit made a Charge move or was charged this turn.

offence.name: Holy Piety (re-roll Hit melee) — Ministorum Priest
offence.desc: Re-roll Hit on melee attacks unless this model's unit is Battle-shocked.

offence.name: Called Shots (re-roll 1 Hit/Wound/Damage) — Rogal Dorn Commander
offence.desc: Re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll each time this model shoots — modelled exactly as a single re-roll of the worst hit, wound and damage die.

offence.name: Bring it Down! (re-roll Hit/Wound of 1 vs Monster/Vehicle) — Catachan Heavy Weapons Squad
offence.desc: Re-roll Hit of 1 and Wound of 1 vs Monster/Vehicle targets.

offence.name: Senior Officer (Cadian Castellan: [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ranged)
offence.desc: While Cadian Castellan is leading this unit, ranged weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (passive — stacks with Orders). Attachable to Cadian Shock Troops or Kasrkin.

offence.name: War Hymns ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] melee) — Ministorum Priest leading
offence.desc: Melee weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] while Ministorum Priest is leading.

offence.name: Leading the Charge (Devastating Wounds melee after Charge) — Lord Marshal Dreir
offence.desc: Melee weapons in Dreir's unit gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] for the turn after they make a Charge move. Toggle when modelling that scenario.

offence.name: Withering Hail (+1 AP vs nominated target) — Leman Russ Exterminator
offence.desc: After the Exterminator shoots, +1 AP for all friendly Astra Militarum vs the enemy unit it hit. Army-wide. Toggle when modelling that nominated target.

offence.name: Transport Support (re-roll Hit vs nominated, disembarked) — Taurox Prime
offence.desc: After the Taurox shoots, units that disembarked from it this turn re-roll Hit vs the enemy unit it hit. Toggle when both conditions apply.

offence.name: Born Soldiers — REGIMENT [LETHAL HITS] (ranged, vs non-Vehicle/Monster)
offence.desc: REGIMENT units' ranged attacks vs a unit that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE gain [LETHAL HITS]. Auto-filters by attacker and target keyword.

offence.name: Born Soldiers — SQUADRON [LETHAL HITS] (ranged, vs Vehicle/Monster)
offence.desc: SQUADRON units' ranged attacks vs a MONSTER or VEHICLE gain [LETHAL HITS]. Auto-filters by attacker and target keyword.

offence.name: Ruthless Discipline — re-roll Hit of 1 (while under an Order)
offence.desc: While the unit is affected by an Order, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Toggle when the unit has been issued an Order.

offence.name: Fire Zone Purge — +1 Hit (arrived from Reserves / disembarked)
offence.desc: +1 to the Hit roll for a MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit's ranged attacks in a turn it was set up from Reserves or disembarked from a Transport. Toggle when modelling that turn.

offence.name: Armoured Fist — +1 Wound (disembarked this turn, ranged)
offence.desc: +1 to the Wound roll for ranged attacks made in a turn the unit disembarked from a Transport. Toggle when modelling that turn.

offence.name: Incendiary Bombardment — target cannot have Benefit of Cover
offence.desc: Artillery Support choice: nominated enemy units >12" away are scattered and cannot have the Benefit of Cover this round. Toggle when you picked this stance against the target.

defence.name: Masters of Camouflage — Stealth (Benefit of Cover, ranged)
defence.desc: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units (excluding TITANIC units) have Stealth: the Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks (always on in this detachment).

defence.name: Smoke Shells — Stealth (Benefit of Cover, ranged)
defence.desc: Artillery Support choice: selected units gain the Stealth ability this battle round (Benefit of Cover vs ranged). Toggle when you picked this stance.

defence.name: Omnissiah’s Blessing — 4+ invulnerable (Enginseer within 3")
defence.desc: A Tech-Priest Enginseer in this army can give one friendly ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE within 3" a 4+ invulnerable save until the start of the next Command phase. Toggle when one is supporting this vehicle.

defence.name: Order: Take Cover! (+1 Save, max 3+)
defence.desc: Voice of Command: an OFFICER can order Take Cover! — improve the Save characteristic of models in the ordered unit by 1 (cannot improve beyond 3+, so this toggle only appears for units with a 4+ save or worse). Toggle when this unit was given the order.

offence.name: Psychic Guidance (+1 to Hit) — Wraithguard/Wraithblades
offence.desc: While within 12" of a friendly Aeldari Psyker, +1 to the Hit roll. Wraithguard and Wraithblades.

offence.name: Psychic Guidance (+1 BS/WS) — Wraithlord
offence.desc: While Wraithlord is within 12" of a friendly Aeldari Psyker, improve BS and WS by 1 (= +1 to Hit).

offence.name: Fated Hero (re-roll Hits/Wounds of 1 vs selected keyword) — Wraithlord
offence.desc: At start of battle, pick Infantry, Monster, Mounted, or Vehicle. Re-roll Hits of 1 and Wounds of 1 vs targets with that keyword. Toggle when the modelled target matches.

offence.name: Swift Demise (re-roll Hits of 1 ranged) — Windriders
offence.desc: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1. Check the child toggle when the target is the closest eligible target for the full re-roll.

offence.name: Swift Demise — target is the closest eligible (full re-roll)
offence.desc: When the target is the closest eligible target: re-roll ALL Hit rolls (replaces the re-roll-1s).

offence.name: Bladestorm ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] within half range) — Dire Avengers
offence.desc: Ranged weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] while targeting an enemy unit within half range. Toggle the half-range Conditions box too.

offence.name: Skyhunter (+1 Hit/Wound vs FLY) — Crimson Hunter
offence.desc: +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound vs targets that can FLY. Toggle when modelling an Aircraft / Jetbike / Flyer target.

offence.name: Reavers of the Void (re-roll Hits of 1) — Corsair Voidreavers
offence.desc: Re-roll Hits of 1. Check the child toggle when the target is on an objective marker for the full re-roll.

offence.name: Reavers of the Void — target on an objective (full re-roll)
offence.desc: When the target is within range of an objective marker: re-roll ALL Hit rolls (replaces the re-roll-1s).

offence.name: Piratical Raiders ([LETHAL HITS] + [PRECISION] vs nominated) — Corsair Voidscarred
offence.desc: At start of battle pick one enemy unit. Attacks vs that unit gain [LETHAL HITS] and [PRECISION]. Toggle when modelling that nominated target.

offence.name: Preternatural Precision (1CP) — Aspect Host
offence.desc: Your Shooting phase, before this unit shoots. Pick ONE ability below — or TWO if you remove an Aspect Shrine token. Until end of phase this unit’s ranged weapons gain the selected ability.

offence.name: Preternatural Precision — [IGNORES COVER] (ranged)
offence.desc: Selected ranged weapons ignore the target’s Benefit of Cover. Toggle the Conditions “in cover” box to see the effect.

offence.name: Preternatural Precision — [LETHAL HITS] (ranged)
offence.desc: Selected ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS]: Critical Hits auto-wound.

offence.name: Preternatural Precision — [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (ranged)
offence.desc: Selected ranged weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]: each Critical Hit generates 1 extra hit.

offence.name: Aspect Shrine tokens
offence.desc: 1 token for every 5 models. Each token changes one Hit roll or one Wound roll of this unit (not a CHARACTER) to an unmodified 6, one time in the battle. On: this attack spends every token on failed rolls, Hit or Wound, whichever adds more damage.

offence.name: Assured Destruction (full re-rolls vs Monster/Vehicle) — Fire Dragons
offence.desc: In your Shooting phase, ranged attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit re-roll the Hit, Wound and Damage rolls.

offence.name: Crystal Matrix (re-roll one Hit + one Wound) — Fire Prism
offence.desc: Re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound roll per shoot — modelled exactly as a single re-roll of the worst hit and wound die.

offence.name: Storm of Silence (re-roll Wound vs CHARACTER) — Jain Zar
offence.desc: Re-roll Wound vs CHARACTER targets. Toggle when modelling a Character.

offence.name: Structural Collapse (re-roll Damage of 1) — D-Cannon Platform
offence.desc: Re-roll Damage of 1 with the D-Cannon; full Damage re-roll vs Titanic. Modelled as full re-roll here.

offence.name: Dance of Death: Hero's Prowess (re-roll Hits of 1) — Troupe
offence.desc: Pick at the start of the Fight phase. Re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

offence.name: Dance of Death: Villain's Doom (+1 to Wound) — Troupe
offence.desc: Pick at the start of the Fight phase. Add 1 to the Wound roll.

offence.name: Hand of Asuryan (Bloody Twins D=3, Anti-Inf 5+, Devastating) — Asurmen
offence.desc: Once per battle. The Bloody Twins becomes D=3 with [Anti-Infantry 5+] and [Devastating Wounds]. Applies to that weapon only — not to the rest of the unit.

offence.name: Fire Support (re-roll Wounds vs the marked target) — Falcon
offence.desc: After the Falcon shoots, one enemy unit it hit is marked. Models that disembarked from that Falcon this turn re-roll Wound rolls against the marked unit. Tick this only for a unit that actually disembarked from a Falcon this turn and is shooting that target. Transport capacity is Aeldari Infantry, so this is offered to Infantry — the Falcon cannot carry Jump Pack models.

offence.name: Cruel Amusement — Shrieker Cannon [SUSTAINED HITS 3] — Death Jester
offence.desc: Each time the Death Jester shoots, his Shrieker Cannon gains one of [IGNORES COVER], [PRECISION] or [SUSTAINED HITS 3].

offence.name: Cruel Amusement — Shrieker Cannon [IGNORES COVER] — Death Jester
offence.desc: Each time the Death Jester shoots, his Shrieker Cannon gains one of [IGNORES COVER], [PRECISION] or [SUSTAINED HITS 3].

offence.name: Blitz (+3 A to Solitaire weapons, 1/battle) — Solitaire
offence.desc: Once per battle. +3 to the Attacks characteristic of the Solitaire's weapons.

offence.name: Overlord (lead: re-roll Wounds of 1) — Ynnari Archon
offence.desc: While Archon leads this unit: re-roll Wounds of 1. Check the child toggle when the unit is below Starting Strength for the full re-roll.

offence.name: Overlord — unit below Starting Strength (full re-roll)
offence.desc: While the unit is below its Starting Strength: re-roll ALL Wound rolls (replaces the re-roll-1s).

offence.name: Eldrad: Doom (+1 to Wound vs nominated enemy)
offence.desc: +1 to Wound vs the enemy unit Eldrad selected for Doom. Toggle when modelling that target.

offence.name: Farseer: Guide (+1 to Hit vs nominated enemy)
offence.desc: +1 to Hit vs the enemy unit Farseer selected for Guide. Toggle when modelling that target.

offence.name: Farseer Skyrunner: Guide (+1 to Hit vs nominated enemy)
offence.desc: +1 to Hit vs the enemy unit Farseer Skyrunner selected for Guide.

offence.name: Yvraine: Herald of Ynnead (re-roll Wounds of 1 vs nominated melee target)
offence.desc: +1 to Wound (of 1) on melee attacks vs the enemy unit Yvraine selected. Toggle when modelling that target.

offence.name: Spiritseer: Spirit Mark ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs nominated)
offence.desc: Spiritseer picks one Wraith Construct unit within 6" + one enemy unit. Until next Movement phase, that Wraith unit's weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs that enemy. Toggle when modelling that nominated target.

offence.name: Target Acquisition ([IGNORES COVER] after long-rifle hit) — Shroud Runners
offence.desc: After hitting an enemy with a long rifle, that enemy loses Benefit of Cover until end of phase. Toggle when modelling subsequent ranged attacks into that target.

offence.name: Shepherds of the Dead — WRAITH CONSTRUCT +1 Hit/+1 Wound (vs token unit)
offence.desc: WRAITH CONSTRUCT attacks vs an enemy unit carrying a Vengeful Dead token (one that destroyed a friendly ASURYANI PSYKER) get +1 Hit and +1 Wound. Toggle when firing at that unit.

offence.name: Defend at All Costs — +1 Hit (near an objective)
offence.desc: DIRE AVENGER / GUARDIAN / SUPPORT WEAPON / WAR WALKER units get +1 to Hit while the unit and/or the target is within range of an objective marker. Toggle when on/contesting an objective.

offence.name: Path of the Warrior — re-roll Hit of 1
offence.desc: ASPECT WARRIORS / AVATAR units re-roll a Hit roll of 1 (pick this or the Wound version each time they shoot/fight).

offence.name: Path of the Warrior — re-roll Wound of 1
offence.desc: ASPECT WARRIORS / AVATAR units re-roll a Wound roll of 1 instead.

offence.name: Boons of the Brood — HARLEQUINS MOUNTED/VEHICLE [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
offence.desc: Weapons equipped by HARLEQUINS MOUNTED and HARLEQUINS VEHICLE models have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (always on in this detachment).

offence.name: Boons of the Brood — [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (disembarked this turn)
offence.desc: Each time a HARLEQUINS unit disembarks from a Transport, until the end of the turn its weapons have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Toggle when modelling that turn.

defence.name: Dance of Distortion — HARLEQUINS Stealth (Benefit of Cover, ranged)
defence.desc: Friendly HARLEQUINS units have Stealth: the Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks (always on in this detachment).

offence.name: Hunter of Souls - re-roll Hit & Wound of 1 (vs CHARACTER)
offence.desc: Attacks that target a CHARACTER unit re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. Toggle when the target is a CHARACTER.

offence.name: Hunter of Souls - FULL Hit & Wound re-rolls (vs PSYKER CHARACTER)
offence.desc: Against a PSYKER CHARACTER unit, re-roll the Hit roll and the Wound roll outright. Toggle when the target is a PSYKER CHARACTER.

offence.name: Hexwarp Flow of Magic (re-roll Wounds of 1 on Psychic)
offence.desc: Re-roll Wound of 1 on Psychic Attacks. Universal — applies anywhere on the board. Filters to weapons with the [PSYCHIC] keyword.

offence.name: Hexwarp: wholly within Flow of Magic (+1 to Wound on Psychic)
offence.desc: +1 to Wound on Psychic Attacks INSTEAD of the re-roll. Toggle when modelling the in-FoM case (replaces the base re-roll above — pick one).

offence.name: Kindred Sorcery: Psychic Maelstrom (+1 to Wound on Psychic)
offence.desc: +1 to Wound on Psychic weapons. Once per battle (radio with the other two Kindred picks).

offence.name: Kindred Sorcery: Wrath of the Immaterium ([DEVASTATING WOUNDS] Psychic)
offence.desc: Psychic weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]. Once per battle.

offence.name: Warpfire Infusion - within 6" of a PSYKER (re-roll one Hit, one Wound and one Damage)
offence.desc: Vehicle within 6" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER: re-roll one Hit, one Wound and one Damage roll — modelled exactly as a single re-roll of the worst hit, wound and damage die.

offence.name: Warpfire Infusion - re-roll one Hit roll
offence.desc: Pick one re-roll each time the vehicle shoots or fights.

offence.name: Warpfire Infusion - re-roll one Wound roll
offence.desc: Pick one re-roll each time the vehicle shoots or fights.

offence.name: Warpfire Infusion - re-roll one Damage roll
offence.desc: Pick one re-roll each time the vehicle shoots or fights.

offence.name: Warpmeld Sacrifice — +1 Wound (TZEENTCH MUTANT)
offence.desc: A TZEENTCH MUTANT (Tzaangors etc.) unit can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice when it attacks: +1 to Wound (it then suffers D3 mortal wounds). Toggle when sacrificing.

offence.name: Cabal Ritual: +1 AP (friendly attacks vs target)
offence.desc: Tsons cabal ritual — +1 AP for friendly attacks targeting the marked enemy unit. Mutually exclusive with the +2 AP toggle.

offence.name: Cabal Ritual: +2 AP (friendly attacks vs target)
offence.desc: Tsons cabal ritual — +2 AP (the higher-roll version) for friendly attacks targeting the marked enemy unit.

offence.name: Cabal Ritual: Re-roll Hits of 1
offence.desc: Tsons cabal ritual — re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for friendly attacks targeting the marked enemy. Mutually exclusive with the full Hit re-roll toggle.

offence.name: Cabal Ritual: Full Hit re-roll
offence.desc: Tsons cabal ritual — full Hit re-roll (higher-roll version) for friendly attacks targeting the marked enemy.

defence.name: Daemonic Illusions — 4+ invulnerable (vs ranged)
defence.desc: While within 6" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER, SCINTILLATING LEGIONS models have a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

defence.name: Warpmeld Sacrifice — −1 to be wounded (TZEENTCH MUTANT)
defence.desc: A TZEENTCH MUTANT unit selected as a target can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice: −1 to be Wounded (it then suffers D3 mortal wounds). Toggle when sacrificing.

defence.name: All is Dust — +1 save (vs Damage-1 attacks)
defence.desc: RUBRICAE models add 1 to armour saves against attacks with an unmodified Damage of 1. Toggle when the incoming weapon is Damage 1.

offence.name: Devastating Assault — hellforged weapons [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] (charged this turn)
offence.desc: Each time this model makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, its hellforged weapons have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

offence.name: Legendary Killer - re-roll Hit & Wound of 1 (melee, led by Khârn)
offence.desc: While Khârn is leading this unit, its melee attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. Applied automatically while he is attached.

offence.name: Driven by Ultimate Rage - re-roll Hit & Wound of 1 (melee, within 6" of Angron)
offence.desc: While a friendly WORLD EATERS unit is within 6" of Angron, its melee attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. Toggle when this unit is inside the aura.

offence.name: Relentless Rage (+1 A melee)
offence.desc: Friendly WORLD EATERS units' melee attacks have +1 A (always on in Berzerker Warband).

offence.name: Idol of Infinite Rage (+1 Hit, +1 Wound — Jakhals/Goremongers near MONSTER)
offence.desc: Jakhals/Goremongers within 6" of a WE MONSTER (or 9" of a WE TITANIC) gain +1 Hit and +1 Wound. Pick Idol of Infinite Rage in your Command phase.

offence.name: Wrath of Khorne — CHARACTER melee [CLEAVE 1]
offence.desc: When a WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HEROES) is selected to fight, its CHARACTER models' melee attacks have [CLEAVE 1] or +1 AP (pick one).

offence.name: Wrath of Khorne — CHARACTER melee +1 AP
offence.desc: When a WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HEROES) is selected to fight, its CHARACTER models' melee attacks have [CLEAVE 1] or +1 AP (pick one).

offence.name: Daemonic Rage ([LANCE] melee — Blood Legions when charging)
offence.desc: Blood Legions melee weapons gain [LANCE]: +1 to Wound on the turn they charge. Spend 3 BTP at start of Command phase. Toggle when modelling the charge turn.

offence.name: Rush to the Fray ([LANCE] melee after disembark + charge)
offence.desc: After this unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT, melee weapons gain [LANCE] (+1 to Wound when charging) and +1 to Charge rolls. Toggle when modelling the disembark + charge case.

offence.name: Blessing: Martial Excellence ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] melee)
offence.desc: Activation: double 4+ or any triple. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Toggle when this Blessing is active.

offence.name: Blessing: Warp Blades ([LETHAL HITS] melee)
offence.desc: Activation: double 5+ or triple 2+. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Toggle when this Blessing is active.

offence.name: Blessing: Decapitating Strikes ([DEVASTATING WOUNDS] melee vs INFANTRY)
offence.desc: Activation: double 6 or triple 3+. Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an INFANTRY unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability. Auto-filtered to INFANTRY targets.

offence.name: Blessing: Total Carnage (destroyed models fight on 4+)
offence.desc: Activation: double 4+ or any triple. Models destroyed before fighting still fight on a 4+ — modelled as each attack kept on a coin-flip 4+ (half output), showing what the unit deals if it swings posthumously. Toggle to model the fight-on-death case.

defence.name: Idol of Blessed Blood — 4+ invulnerable (Jakhals/Goremongers)
defence.desc: While within 6" of a friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER (9" of a TITANIC), JAKHALS/GOREMONGERS models have a 4+ invulnerable save. Pick the Idol of Blessed Blood.

defence.name: Boon of Blood — 4+ invulnerable (Blood Legions)
defence.desc: Spend 4 BTP: BLOOD LEGIONS (Daemon) units have a 4+ invulnerable save until end of battle.

offence.name: Blight Bombardment - re-roll Hits of 1; BLAST re-rolls the Hit roll (vs the marked unit)
offence.desc: Lord of Virulence: at the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 30". Friendly DEATH GUARD ranged attacks at it re-roll Hit rolls of 1, and attacks made with [BLAST] weapons re-roll the Hit roll outright. The Blast half applies per profile: the frag profile of a missile launcher is Blast, the krak profile is not. Toggle when firing at the marked unit.

offence.name: Nurgle's Gift (target in Contagion Range: −1 Toughness)
offence.desc: Enemy units within Contagion Range of a Death Guard unit have −1 Toughness (range grows over rounds). Toggle when the target is in range.

offence.name: Afflicted: Rattlejoint Ague (target Save worsened by 1)
offence.desc: Nurgle’s Gift with Rattlejoint Ague as the chosen Plague: the Save characteristic of Afflicted (in-Contagion-Range) enemy models is worsened by 1 — modelled as +1 AP on your attacks. Toggle when the target is in Contagion Range and Rattlejoint is your Plague.

defence.name: Afflicted: Skullsquirm Blight — attacker −1 to Hit (melee, within Contagion Range)
defence.desc: Nurgle’s Gift: while the attacking unit is within Contagion Range (3"/6"/9" by round) it is Afflicted (−1 Toughness), and with Skullsquirm Blight as the chosen Plague its MELEE attacks subtract 1 from the Hit roll. Toggle when the attacker is inside Contagion Range and Skullsquirm is your Plague.

defence.name: Afflicted: Skullsquirm Blight — Benefit of Cover (ranged, within Contagion Range)
defence.desc: The other half of Skullsquirm Blight: each time an Afflicted model makes a RANGED attack, its enemies have the benefit of cover against that attack — so your unit is in cover no matter the terrain. Toggle when the attacker is inside Contagion Range and Skullsquirm is your Plague.

offence.name: Mechanised Murder (re-roll 1 Hit + 1 Wound — TRANSPORT/disembarked)
offence.desc: Re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1 for TRANSPORT models, or models that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.

offence.name: Frantic Focus ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] — BATTLELINE, after Advancing or Falling Back)
offence.desc: When a friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move, that unit's BATTLELINE models' attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] until the end of the turn.

offence.name: Daemonic Empowerment ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] — within 6" of LoE/EC)
offence.desc: Empowered (EC within 6" of LoE, or LoE within 6" of EC). Weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. If the weapon already has SUSTAINED HITS 1, use the Crit-on-5+ toggle instead.

offence.name: Daemonic Empowerment (Crit on 5+ — for weapons that already had [SUSTAINED HITS 1])
offence.desc: When Empowered, weapons that already had [SUSTAINED HITS 1] before the Empowered buff score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit of 5+ instead of stacking another SUSTAINED HITS 1.

offence.name: Internal Rivalries — Favoured Champions re-roll Wound
offence.desc: Your army's Favoured Champions unit (your Warlord's unit, or the last CHARACTER unit to destroy an enemy) re-rolls the Wound roll. Toggle when this CHARACTER is the Favoured Champions.

offence.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship — melee [LETHAL HITS] (charged)
offence.desc: On a turn the unit charged, pick [LETHAL HITS] for its melee weapons. Toggle with the Charged condition.

offence.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship — melee [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (charged)
offence.desc: Or pick [SUSTAINED HITS 1] instead.

offence.name: Pledges (1+ Pact) — re-roll Hit of 1
offence.desc: At 1+ Pact points: re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Cumulative with the higher thresholds.

offence.name: Pledges (3+ Pact) — re-roll Wound of 1
offence.desc: At 3+ Pact points: also re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

offence.name: Pledges (5+ Pact) — melee [LETHAL HITS] + [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
offence.desc: At 5+ Pact points: melee weapons also gain [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

offence.name: Pledges (7+ Pact) — Critical Hit on 5+
offence.desc: At 7+ Pact points: a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

offence.name: Sensational Performance — +1 S, +1 AP melee (charged)
offence.desc: On a turn the unit charged, +1 Strength and +1 AP to its melee weapons (it then cannot target units it was already engaging / others have hit). Toggle with the Charged condition.

offence.name: Fates in Flux - spend a Flux token to re-roll one Hit roll
offence.desc: Spend one Flux token just after a Hit roll is made for this LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit to re-roll it. Modelled as a single re-roll of the worst Hit die. Toggle when you intend to spend a token on Hits (your opponent then gains that token).

offence.name: Fates in Flux - spend a Flux token to re-roll one Wound roll
offence.desc: Spend one Flux token just after a Wound roll is made for this unit to re-roll it. Modelled as a single re-roll of the worst Wound die. Toggle when spending a token on Wounds.

offence.name: Fates in Flux - spend a Flux token to re-roll one Damage roll
offence.desc: Spend one Flux token just after a Damage roll is made for this unit to re-roll it. Modelled as a single re-roll of the lowest Damage die. Toggle when spending a token on Damage.

offence.name: Within Shadow of Chaos (re-roll Hits of 1)
offence.desc: While controlling the battlefield around them (Shadow of Chaos), Daemons re-roll Hit rolls of 1. Approximate model of the offensive half — verify for your detachment.

offence.name: Seductive Gambit — re-roll Hit + re-roll Wound of 1 (charged)
offence.desc: LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit that ended a Charge move can re-roll the Hit roll and re-roll a Wound roll of 1 (it forgoes Fights First). Toggle with the Charged condition.

defence.name: Penumbral Puppetry — −1 to be hit (melee, TZEENTCH)
defence.desc: SHADOW LEGION TZEENTCH units: each melee attack targeting the unit is −1 to Hit (always on).

defence.name: Penumbral Puppetry — Stealth (Benefit of Cover, ranged, TZEENTCH)
defence.desc: SHADOW LEGION TZEENTCH units have Stealth: the Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks (always on).

defence.name: Gloam Rot — −1 to be wounded (NURGLE, S>T)
defence.desc: SHADOW LEGION NURGLE units: −1 to be Wounded by attacks whose Strength exceeds their Toughness (always on).

defence.name: Brass Collar of Bloody Vengeance — Feel No Pain 3+ vs mortal wounds
defence.desc: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.

defence.name: Brass Collar of Bloody Vengeance — Feel No Pain 3+ vs Psychic attacks
defence.desc: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.

offence.name: Overlapping Destruction (heavy bolters have [BLAST 1] vs the picked unit)
offence.desc: In your Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit. Heavy Bolter weapons in this unit have [BLAST 1] when targeting that unit.

offence.name: Overlapping Detonations (heavy bolters have [BLAST 1] vs the picked unit)
offence.desc: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot you can select one non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy unit visible to it. While making attacks, this unit's heavy bolters that targeted that selected unit have [BLAST 1].

offence.name: Executioner (+1 Hit vs Below Half-strength) — Repulsor Executioner
offence.desc: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll.

offence.name: Martial Exemplar - re-roll Hit & Wound of 1 (melee, within 6" of the Lion)
offence.desc: While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within 6" of Lion El’Jonson, its melee attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. Applies to the Lion’s own attacks as well. Toggle when the unit is inside the aura.

offence.name: Aquilon Optics (re-roll 1 Hit/Wound/Damage) — Gladiator Lancer
offence.desc: Each time this model is selected to shoot, re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.

offence.name: Aqullon Optics (re-roll 1 Hit/Wound/Damage) — Gladiator Lancer
offence.desc: Each time this model is selected to shoot, re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.

offence.name: Wrath of Dorn - DARNATH LYSANDER re-roll Wound vs Oath target
offence.desc: A DARNATH LYSANDER unit re-rolls the whole Wound roll (not just 1s) against your Oath of Moment target. Toggle when Lysander's unit is firing at or fighting the Oath target.

offence.name: Anointed Champion - re-roll one Hit and one Wound (melee)
offence.desc: Whenever the EMPEROR'S CHAMPION is selected to fight, its melee attacks re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound roll - modelled as a single re-roll of the worst Hit die and the worst Wound die. Always on in this detachment.

offence.name: Black-Winged Vigilance - ranged [IGNORES COVER]
offence.desc: RAVENWING FLY units: ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]. Always on.

offence.name: Imperator Unleashed - re-roll Hits of 1 (ingress/charge turn)
offence.desc: In a turn the unit made an ingress or charge move, its attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1. Toggle when modelling that turn.

offence.name: Oath of Moment (target = your Oath unit)
offence.desc: Re-roll Hit rolls against your Oath of Moment target (one enemy unit chosen each Command phase).

offence.name: Headhunters (target = this unit's quarry)
offence.desc: Wolf Guard Headtakers: the unit's attacks have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [PRECISION] against its quarry (picked at the start of the first battle round). Toggle when firing at the quarry. ([PRECISION] affects wound allocation, not damage output, so only [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] changes the math.)

offence.name: Mass of Doom (made a charge move this turn)
offence.desc: Astorath: in a turn in which his unit made a charge move, its melee attacks have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] against targets that are not MONSTER or VEHICLE units. Toggle on the charge.

offence.name: Priority Objective Identified (target near the marked objective)
offence.desc: Lieutenant with Combi-weapon: re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES models attacking an enemy unit within range of the objective marker selected at the start of the battle. Toggle when the target is in range of that marker.

offence.name: Templar Vow: Accept Any Challenge (+1 Wound when S ≤ T)
offence.desc: Black Templars Vow: while Accept Any Challenge is your active Vow, +1 to the Wound roll each time your weapon's Strength is less than or equal to the target's Toughness. Toggle when modelling that matchup.

offence.name: Shield of the Imperium — Remained Stationary (+1 Hit, granted [HEAVY])
offence.desc: Weapons WITHOUT [HEAVY] gain it while the unit Remained Stationary (+1 Hit). Toggle when stationary. (Weapons that already have [HEAVY] get the +1 Wound toggle below instead.)

offence.name: Shield of the Imperium — already-[HEAVY] weapons (+1 Wound, stationary)
offence.desc: Weapons that ALREADY have [HEAVY] instead get +1 to Wound while the unit Remained Stationary (auto-restricted to [HEAVY] weapons).

offence.name: Armoured Wrath — re-roll one Hit / Wound / Damage
offence.desc: Once per phase per unit, re-roll one Hit, one Wound or one Damage roll — modelled as a single re-roll of the worst of each.

offence.name: Close-range Eradication — +1 Strength (ranged, within 12")
offence.desc: Ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] and +1 Strength vs targets within 12". Toggle with the half-range Condition. (12" — toggle when in range.)

offence.name: Extremis-level Threat — re-roll Wound vs Oath target (once per battle)
offence.desc: Once per battle, also re-roll the Wound roll vs your Oath of Moment target (on top of Oath's Hit re-roll). Toggle when firing at the Oath target that round.

offence.name: Psychic Discipline: Divination (re-roll Hit 1 + Wound 1)
offence.desc: PSYKER units re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1. One Discipline active per battle round.

offence.name: Psychic Discipline: Pyromancy (+1 AP ranged, within 12")
offence.desc: PSYKER ranged attacks vs targets within 12" improve AP by 1. Toggle with the half-range Condition.

offence.name: Psychic Discipline: Telepathy (ignore Hit modifiers)
offence.desc: PSYKER units ignore any/all modifiers to WS/BS and the Hit roll.

offence.name: Interlocking Tactics — re-roll Hit of 1 (vs auspex-scanned target)
offence.desc: Re-roll a Hit roll of 1 vs a unit your BATTLELINE auspex-scanned (a unit they hit this turn). Toggle when firing at that unit.

offence.name: Rapid-drop Deployment — re-roll Wound of 1 (set up this turn)
offence.desc: Re-roll a Wound roll of 1 if the unit was set up on the battlefield this turn. Toggle on the arrival turn.

offence.name: Rapid-drop Deployment — re-roll Hit of 1 (Drop Pod disembark)
offence.desc: Re-roll a Hit roll of 1 if the unit disembarked from a DROP POD this turn. Toggle when modelling that.

offence.name: Adaptive Defence — in terrain (re-roll Hit 1 + Wound 1)
offence.desc: While the unit is within a terrain feature, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1. Toggle when in terrain.

offence.name: Target Sighted — TANK ACE re-roll Damage (did not Advance)
offence.desc: TANK ACE (most non-Walker/Fly VEHICLE) units re-roll the Damage roll when they shoot without having Advanced. Toggle when stationary/moved-only.

offence.name: Wrath of Dorn — re-roll Wound of 1 vs Oath target (Imperial Fists)
offence.desc: Also re-roll a Wound roll of 1 vs your Oath of Moment target. Toggle when firing at the Oath target.

offence.name: Oath of Reclamation — +1 AP melee (target on an objective)
offence.desc: Melee attacks vs a unit within range of an objective marker improve AP by 1. Toggle when the target holds/contests an objective.

offence.name: Vulkan's Quest — +1 Strength (ranged, within 12in)
offence.desc: Ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] and +1 Strength vs targets within 12". Toggle with the half-range Condition.

offence.name: Calculated Annihilation — re-roll Wound of 1 vs Oath target (Iron Hands)
offence.desc: Also re-roll a Wound roll of 1 vs your Oath of Moment target. Toggle when firing at the Oath target.

offence.name: Shock and Awe — +1 Hit melee (disembarked this turn)
offence.desc: +1 to the Hit roll on melee attacks if the unit disembarked from a Transport this turn. Toggle when modelling that.

offence.name: Red Thirst — charged: +1 A, +2 S melee (Blood Angels)
offence.desc: On a turn the unit made a Charge move, +1 Attacks and +2 Strength to its melee weapons. Toggle with the Charged condition.

offence.name: A Noble Death — Death Company re-roll Wound of 1 (melee)
offence.desc: DEATH COMPANY melee attacks re-roll a Wound roll of 1 while below Starting Strength. Check the child toggle when Below Half-strength for the full re-roll.

offence.name: A Noble Death — Below Half-strength (full re-roll)
offence.desc: While the unit is Below Half-strength: re-roll ALL melee Wound rolls (replaces the re-roll-1s).

offence.name: Legacy: Carmine Wrath — CHARACTER re-roll Hit 1 + Wound 1
offence.desc: ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER units re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1 (one of two Angelic Legacy picks).

offence.name: Maddened Ferocity — re-roll Wound 1 melee
offence.desc: Melee attacks re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Use the +1 Attacks toggle below on a turn the unit charged.

offence.name: Maddened Ferocity — after a Charge (+1 Attack melee)
offence.desc: On a turn the unit made a Charge move, its melee weapons get +1 Attack.

offence.name: Maddened Ferocity — also Battle-shocked (+1 more Attack)
offence.desc: If the charging unit is also Battle-shocked, the Attacks bonus is +2 total (this adds the second +1).

offence.name: Vowed Target — DEATHWING +1 Wound (target on Vowed objective)
offence.desc: DEATHWING INFANTRY +1 to the Wound roll vs a unit within range of your Vowed objective marker. Toggle when firing at that unit.

offence.name: Pack's Quarry — +1 Hit melee (flanked / outnumbering)
offence.desc: +1 to the Hit roll on melee attacks vs an enemy within Engagement Range of another friendly unit, or while you outnumber it. (Saga completed adds +1 Wound — use the other toggle.)

offence.name: Pack's Quarry (Saga complete) — +1 Hit + +1 Wound melee
offence.desc: Once your Saga is completed, the same melee attacks also gain +1 to the Wound roll.

offence.name: Heroes All — Saga completed: re-roll one Hit, one Wound and one Damage
offence.desc: Once your Saga is completed, each unit re-rolls one Hit, one Wound and one Damage roll — modelled as a single re-roll of the worst of each.

offence.name: Heroes All — CHARACTER: re-roll one Hit roll
offence.desc: A SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit re-rolls one Hit, one Wound or one Damage roll each time it shoots or fights.

offence.name: Heroes All — CHARACTER: re-roll one Wound roll
offence.desc: A SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit re-rolls one Hit, one Wound or one Damage roll each time it shoots or fights.

offence.name: Heroes All — CHARACTER: re-roll one Damage roll
offence.desc: A SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit re-rolls one Hit, one Wound or one Damage roll each time it shoots or fights.

offence.name: Legendary Slayers — [LETHAL HITS] vs CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE
offence.desc: Attacks vs CHARACTER / MONSTER / VEHICLE targets gain [LETHAL HITS] (all targets once your Saga is completed).

offence.name: Invocations of Ancient Fury — plasma weapons +1 Strength
offence.desc: Weapon profiles with 'Plasma' in their names are plasma weapon profiles and have +1 Strength (always on in this detachment).

offence.name: Hunting Pack: Hunter's Eye (+1 Hit ranged)
offence.desc: +1 to the Hit roll on ranged attacks. One Hunting Pack active per battle round.

offence.name: Hunting Pack: Ferocious Strike ([LETHAL HITS] melee)
offence.desc: When selected to fight, melee weapons gain [LETHAL HITS] (or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] — see other toggle).

offence.name: Hunting Pack: Ferocious Strike ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] melee)
offence.desc: When selected to fight, melee weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (alternative to Lethal Hits).

offence.name: Mission Tactics: Furor ([SUSTAINED HITS 1])
offence.desc: DEATHWATCH weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. One Mission Tactic active per battle round.

offence.name: Mission Tactics: Malleus ([LETHAL HITS])
offence.desc: DEATHWATCH weapons gain [LETHAL HITS]. One Mission Tactic active per battle round.

offence.name: Auto-sense Coordination ([LETHAL HITS])
offence.desc: 1CP. Weapons gain [LETHAL HITS] on a turn the unit disembarked from a Drop Pod, or while targeting an enemy unit within 12". Pick this OR Sustained Hits 1 — not both.

offence.name: Auto-sense Coordination ([SUSTAINED HITS 1])
offence.desc: 1CP. Weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] on a turn the unit disembarked from a Drop Pod, or while targeting an enemy unit within 12". Pick this OR Lethal Hits — not both.

offence.name: Augmented Targeting ([SUSTAINED HITS 1])
offence.desc: 1CP, your Shooting phase. Ranged weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] until end of phase. Pick this OR Lethal Hits — not both, unless the unit is ENTRENCHED.

offence.name: Augmented Targeting ([LETHAL HITS])
offence.desc: 1CP, your Shooting phase. Ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS] until end of phase. Pick this OR Sustained Hits — not both, unless the unit is ENTRENCHED.

offence.name: Augmented Targeting · ENTRENCHED ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] + [LETHAL HITS])
offence.desc: 1CP, your Shooting phase. An ENTRENCHED unit does not choose — its ranged weapons gain BOTH [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [LETHAL HITS] until end of phase.

defence.name: Shields of the Imperium — re-roll invulnerable saves of 1
defence.desc: Bladeguard choice at the start of the Fight phase: each time an invulnerable saving throw is made for a model in this unit, re-roll a saving throw of 1. Toggle when picking Shields (instead of Swords).

defence.name: Shadow Masters — Benefit of Cover (attacker over 12")
defence.desc: Each ranged attack from over 12" away grants the target the Benefit of Cover.

defence.name: Masters of Shadow — Benefit of Cover (attacker over 12")
defence.desc: Each ranged attack from over 12" away grants the target the Benefit of Cover (Raven Guard).

defence.name: Psychic Discipline: Telekinesis (−1 incoming Strength)
defence.desc: Ranged attacks vs this PSYKER unit subtract 1 from their Strength (modelled as +1 effective Toughness). One Discipline active per battle round.

defence.name: Oath of Reclamation — −1 to be wounded (near objective, S>T)
defence.desc: While within range of an objective you controlled at the start of the phase, −1 to be Wounded by attacks whose Strength exceeds your Toughness (or vs TITUS). Toggle when on the objective.

defence.name: Purge and Sanctify — ANCIENT −1 to be wounded (near objective, S>T)

offence.name: Doctrina: Conqueror Imperative (+1 WS, melee)
offence.desc: Conqueror Imperative: the Weapon Skill of melee weapons is improved by 1 (ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT], which does not change damage output). One Imperative per battle round.

offence.name: Conqueror Imperative — +1 AP (BATTLELINE / within 6" of BATTLELINE)
offence.desc: While Conqueror is active, each attack made by a unit that has BATTLELINE and/or is within 6" of a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE unit improves its AP by 1. Applies to shooting AND melee — toggle when the condition holds.

offence.name: Cawl: Invocation of Machine Vengeance — re-roll Hit (vs Vengeance target)
offence.desc: Belisarius Cawl picks one enemy unit each Command phase as your Machine Vengeance target; friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units re-roll the Hit roll against it. Requires Cawl on the battlefield with this Canticle selected.

offence.name: Panegyric Procession — +1 AP (ranged, target within half range)
offence.desc: CULT MECHANICUS ranged attacks vs a unit within half range improve AP by 1. Toggle with the half-range Condition. (Pick one Benediction for the battle.)

offence.name: Citation in Savagery — +1 S / +1 A (melee, charged)
offence.desc: CULT MECHANICUS melee weapons get +1 Strength and +1 Attacks on a turn the unit charged. Toggle with the Charged condition.

offence.name: Murderous Imperative (Protector) — SKITARII re-roll Hit of 1
offence.desc: While the Protector Imperative is active, SKITARII re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Toggle with the Protector Doctrina.

offence.name: Murderous Imperative (Conqueror) — SKITARII re-roll Wound of 1
offence.desc: While the Conqueror Imperative is active, SKITARII re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Toggle with the Conqueror Doctrina.

offence.name: Acquisition At Any Cost — re-roll Wound of 1 (near Acquisition objective)
offence.desc: Re-roll a Wound roll of 1 while the unit (or its target) is within range of your Acquisition objective marker. Toggle when modelling that.

defence.name: War-Form Mantles - 4+ invulnerable (TECH-PRIEST)
defence.desc: TECH-PRIEST models have a 4+ invulnerable save (always on in this detachment).

defence.name: War-Form Mantles - Feel No Pain 5+ (TECH-PRIEST)
defence.desc: TECH-PRIEST models have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability (always on in this detachment).

defence.name: Protector Imperative — attacker −1 to Hit (melee)
defence.desc: Doctrina Imperatives: while the Protector Imperative is active, each melee attack targeting this unit is −1 to Hit if it has BATTLELINE and/or is within 6" of a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE unit. Toggle when Protector is active and the condition holds.

defence.name: Omnissiah’s Blessing — Feel No Pain 5+ (Enginseer within 3")
defence.desc: A Tech-Priest Enginseer in this army can give one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE within 3" the Feel No Pain 5+ ability until the start of the next Command phase. Toggle when one is supporting this vehicle.

defence.name: Microactuator Bracing (Override) — +1 Toughness
defence.desc: HALO OVERRIDE units can take the Microactuator Bracing override: +1 Toughness. Toggle when this unit chose it.

defence.name: Muted Servomotors (Override) — Stealth (Benefit of Cover, ranged)
defence.desc: HALO OVERRIDE units can take the Muted Servomotors override: Stealth (Benefit of Cover vs ranged). Toggle when this unit chose it.

defence.name: Stealth Optimisation — Stealth (Benefit of Cover, ranged)
defence.desc: SKITARII INFANTRY / MOUNTED / IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII units have the Stealth ability (Benefit of Cover vs ranged).

offence.name: Ka'tah: Dacatarai Stance ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] melee)
offence.desc: Dacatarai Stance: melee weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. One stance per battle round.

offence.name: Ka'tah: Rendax Stance ([LETHAL HITS] melee)
offence.desc: Rendax Stance: melee weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].

offence.name: Moment Shackle — Watcher's Axe A12 (once per battle)
offence.desc: Once per battle (start of the Fight phase): Trajann Valoris' Watcher's Axe has an Attacks characteristic of 12 instead of 6. Toggle to model the boosted profile.

offence.name: Martial Mastery — melee Critical Hit on 5+
offence.desc: MARTIAL KA'TAH models: melee Critical Hit on an unmodified 5+. Pick one Martial Mastery effect per battle round.

offence.name: Martial Mastery — +1 AP (melee)
offence.desc: MARTIAL KA'TAH models: improve melee Armour Penetration by 1.

offence.name: Assemblage of Might — CHARACTER +1 Wound (vs marked enemy)
offence.desc: ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER units add 1 to the Wound roll vs the enemy unit you select each Command phase. Toggle when firing/fighting that unit.

offence.name: Against All Odds — lone unit (+1 Hit, +1 Wound)
offence.desc: +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound while no other friendly units are within 6" of this unit (excludes VEHICLES). Toggle when operating alone.

offence.name: Auric Armour — VEHICLE below Starting Strength (re-roll Hit of 1)
offence.desc: ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE below Starting Strength: re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

offence.name: Auric Armour — VEHICLE Below Half-strength (re-roll Hit + Wound of 1)
offence.desc: ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE Below Half-strength: re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1.

offence.name: Deadly Unity — ANATHEMA PSYKANA +1 Hit (near a Custodes unit)
offence.desc: While an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit is within 6" of another ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit, +1 to its Hit rolls. Toggle when positioned together.

offence.name: Ka'tah: Salvus (ignore BS, Hit and Wound modifiers, ranged)
offence.desc: Salvus: when a readied unit is selected to shoot, it ignores modifiers to its BS, its Hit rolls and its Wound rolls. Using it spends the unit's readied state.

offence.name: Ka'tah: Dacatarai (re-roll Hit rolls of 1 vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE, melee)
offence.desc: Dacatarai: at the start of the Fight phase, a readied unit's melee attacks against a unit that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE may re-roll Hit rolls of 1. Using it spends the unit's readied state.

offence.name: Ka'tah: Rendax ([LETHAL HITS] vs MONSTER/VEHICLE, melee)
offence.desc: Rendax: when a readied unit is selected to fight, its melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS] against a MONSTER or VEHICLE. Using it spends the unit's readied state.

defence.name: Gilded Guardians - -1 to be wounded (ranged, on an objective, S>T)
defence.desc: While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is within range of an objective, a ranged attack against it whose Strength exceeds its Toughness has -1 to the Wound roll. Toggle when it is on an objective.

defence.name: Wardens of the Dark Cells - -1 to be wounded (melee, on an objective, S>T)
defence.desc: While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is within range of an objective, a melee attack against it whose Strength exceeds its Toughness has -1 to the Wound roll. Toggle when it is on an objective.

offence.name: Forward Observers - Guided re-roll Hit & Wound of 1 (Stealth Suits observing, vs the Spotted unit)
offence.desc: When Stealth Battlesuits are this unit’s Observer, its ranged attacks against the Spotted unit re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. Toggle when Guided by Stealth Suits and firing at the Spotted target.

offence.name: Targeting Array (re-roll one Hit OR one Wound)
offence.desc: Each time this model is selected to shoot, re-roll one Hit roll OR one Wound roll - applied automatically where it adds the most damage.

offence.name: Guided (For the Greater Good) — Ballistic Skill +1
offence.desc: A Guided unit attacking its army's Spotted unit improves its Ballistic Skill by 1 (+1 to Hit); if the Spotted unit was marked by a MARKERLIGHT Observer, those attacks also ignore cover. Toggle when this unit is the Guided shooter.

offence.name: Patient Hunter — ranged [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (rounds 3-5)
offence.desc: During battle rounds 3-5, ranged weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Toggle in those rounds.

offence.name: Patient Hunter — Guided ignore Hit modifiers (rounds 3-5)
offence.desc: Rounds 3-5: a Guided unit firing at its Spotted target ignores modifiers to BS and the Hit roll. Toggle when Guided.

offence.name: Killing Blow — Guided ranged [LETHAL HITS] (rounds 1-3)
offence.desc: During battle rounds 1-3, a Guided unit's ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS]. Toggle when Guided in those rounds.

offence.name: Bonded Heroes — BATTLESUIT +1 Strength (ranged, within 12")
offence.desc: BATTLESUIT ranged attacks vs targets within 12" get +1 Strength. Toggle with the half-range Condition.

offence.name: Bonded Heroes — BATTLESUIT +1 AP (ranged, within 9")
offence.desc: BATTLESUIT ranged attacks vs targets within 9" also get +1 AP. Toggle when within 9".

offence.name: Hunter's Instincts — +1 Hit (vs below-Starting-Strength)
offence.desc: KROOT attacks vs a target below its Starting Strength get +1 to Hit. (Below Half-strength also +1 Wound — use the other toggle.)

offence.name: Hunter's Instincts — +1 Hit + +1 Wound (vs Below Half-strength)
offence.desc: KROOT attacks vs a target Below Half-strength get +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound.

defence.name: Skirmish Fighters — 5+ invulnerable (vs ranged)
defence.desc: KROOT models have a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks (always on in this detachment).

defence.name: Skirmish Fighters — 6+ invulnerable (vs melee)
defence.desc: KROOT models have a 6+ invulnerable save against melee attacks (always on in this detachment).

offence.name: Cruel Amusement — Shrieker Cannon [SUSTAINED HITS 3] — Death Jester
offence.desc: Each time the Death Jester shoots, his Shrieker Cannon gains one of [IGNORES COVER], [PRECISION] or [SUSTAINED HITS 3].

offence.name: Cruel Amusement — Shrieker Cannon [IGNORES COVER] — Death Jester
offence.desc: Each time the Death Jester shoots, his Shrieker Cannon gains one of [IGNORES COVER], [PRECISION] or [SUSTAINED HITS 3].

offence.name: Exacting Cruelty - melee [LETHAL HITS] (non-Monster/Vehicle)
offence.desc: Melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS] against non-MONSTER/VEHICLE targets. Always on; drops automatically against a Monster or Vehicle.

offence.name: Contracted Harvest - ranged [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (non-Monster/Vehicle)
offence.desc: Ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] against non-MONSTER/VEHICLE targets. Always on; drops automatically against a Monster or Vehicle.

offence.name: Rain of Cruelty — [IGNORES COVER] (ranged, disembarked)
offence.desc: Ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER] on a turn the unit disembarked from a Transport. Toggle when modelling that.

offence.name: Rain of Cruelty — [LANCE] (melee, disembarked + charged)
offence.desc: Melee weapons gain [LANCE] (+1 Wound on a turn the unit charged) when it disembarked this turn. Toggle with the Charged condition.

offence.name: Combat Drug: Adrenalight (+1 Attack, melee)
offence.desc: WYCH CULT melee weapons +1 Attack. One Combat Drug active per battle round.

offence.name: Combat Drug: Serpentin (+1 WS = +1 Hit, melee)
offence.desc: WYCH CULT +1 Weapon Skill (= +1 to Hit in melee).

offence.name: Combat Drug: Grave Lotus (+1 Strength, melee)
offence.desc: WYCH CULT melee weapons +1 Strength.

offence.name: Combat Drug: Splintermind (+1 BS = +1 Hit, ranged)
offence.desc: WYCH CULT +1 Ballistic Skill (= +1 to Hit at range).

offence.name: Contract: Sow Fear and Terror ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs INF/MOUNTED)
offence.desc: KABAL / BLADES FOR HIRE units gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs the Contract unit (INFANTRY/MOUNTED contract). Toggle when firing at it.

offence.name: Contract: Show of Strength ([LETHAL HITS] vs MONSTER/VEHICLE)
offence.desc: KABAL / BLADES FOR HIRE units gain [LETHAL HITS] vs the Contract unit (MONSTER/VEHICLE contract).

offence.name: Callous Competition — Winning (re-roll Hit of 1)
offence.desc: While your faction is winning the wager, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

offence.name: Callous Competition — Losing (re-roll Hit 1 + Wound 1)
offence.desc: While your faction is losing the wager, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1.

offence.name: Murderous Crossfire (+1 AP, ranged)
offence.desc: After a Scourges w/ Shardcarbines unit shoots, friendly DRUKHARI ranged attacks vs the unit it hit improve Armour Penetration by 1 (until end of phase). Toggle when firing at that target.

defence.name: Combat Drug: Painbringer (+1 Toughness)
defence.desc: WYCH CULT models gain +1 Toughness. One Combat Drug active per battle round.

defence.name: Stitchflesh Abominations — −1 to be wounded (S>T)
defence.desc: HAEMONCULUS COVENS units are −1 to be Wounded by attacks whose Strength exceeds their Toughness (always on).

defence.name: Darkest Artifice — −1 to be wounded (CRONOS/TALOS, S>T)
defence.desc: CRONOS and TALOS units are −1 to be Wounded by attacks whose Strength exceeds their Toughness (always on in this detachment).

offence.name: Crossfire (vs a Crossfired enemy: re-roll Wounds)
offence.desc: When an enemy is caught in Crossfire, your ranged attacks re-roll Wounds against it. Toggle when the target is Crossfired. Approximate — verify trigger.

offence.name: Integrated Tactics — +1 Hit (vs overlapping-fire target)
offence.desc: GENESTEALER CULTS ranged attacks vs an enemy caught in overlapping fire (one your ASTRA MILITARUM targeted) get +1 to Hit. Toggle when firing at that unit.

offence.name: Hypermorphic Fury — +1 Attack melee (charged)
offence.desc: ABERRANTS / BIOPHAGUS / PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS get +1 Attack on their melee weapons on a turn they charged. Toggle with the Charged condition.

offence.name: Catalyst — +1 Hit (vs enemy near a TYRANIDS unit)
offence.desc: GENESTEALER CULTS attacks vs an enemy unit within 6" of a friendly TYRANIDS unit get +1 to Hit. Toggle when applicable.

offence.name: A Perfect Ambush — [SUSTAINED HITS 1] + [IGNORES COVER] (Reinforcements)
offence.desc: A unit set up as Reinforcements gains [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] until end of your next Fight phase. Toggle on the arrival turn.

offence.name: Killer Reputation — KILLER re-roll Hit 1 + Wound 1
offence.desc: KILLER models (Kelermorph, Locus, Reductus Saboteur, Sanctus) re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 (always on in this detachment).

defence.name: Unquestioning Fanaticism — the leading MAGUS/PRIMUS/ICONWARD has Feel No Pain 3+
defence.desc: While a MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD leads an ACOLYTE/METAMORPH/NEOPHYTE unit, that CHARACTER has Feel No Pain 3+ (its squad does not). Toggling it here gives the whole target the save.

offence.name: Storm of Retribution - re-roll Hit & Wound of 1 (ranged)
offence.desc: Ranged attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. Always on.

offence.name: Storm of Retribution - +1 Hit & Wound (target destroyed a SORORITAS unit)
offence.desc: Against an enemy unit that has destroyed one or more ADEPTA SORORITAS units from your army this battle, also add 1 to the Hit roll and 1 to the Wound roll. Toggle when the target qualifies.

offence.name: Miracle dice
offence.desc: Acts of Faith: one Hit, Wound or Damage roll of this attack is a Miracle dice, an unmodified roll of its value. Choose the value; it is spent where it deals the most damage, and not at all where it changes nothing.

offence.name: Value: 6
offence.desc: The Miracle dice shows a 6.

offence.name: Value: 5
offence.desc: The Miracle dice shows a 5.

offence.name: Value: 4
offence.desc: The Miracle dice shows a 4.

offence.name: Value: 3
offence.desc: The Miracle dice shows a 3.

offence.name: Value: 2
offence.desc: The Miracle dice shows a 2.

offence.name: Simulacrum of the Ebon Chalice — two Acts of Faith (within 6" of the Triumph)
offence.desc: While a friendly Adepta Sororitas unit is within 6" of the Triumph of Saint Katherine, it can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase: two Miracle dice of the chosen value.

offence.name: Miracle dice (a 6 where it counts)
offence.desc: Acts of Faith: one Hit, Wound or Damage roll of this unit is substituted by a Miracle dice, which counts as an unmodified roll of its value. A 6 where a Critical Hit or Wound, or a Damage roll, makes it worth more, else the lowest value that passes.

offence.name: Miracle dice (the lowest value that passes)
offence.desc: Acts of Faith: one Hit or Wound roll of this unit is substituted by a Miracle dice, which counts as an unmodified roll of its value: here the lowest value that passes the roll.

offence.name: Miracle dice ×2, Ebon Chalice (a 6 where it counts)
offence.desc: Within 6" of the Triumph of Saint Katherine (Simulacrum of the Ebon Chalice): two Acts of Faith, two Miracle dice; a 6 where it is worth more, else the lowest value that passes.

offence.name: Miracle dice ×2, Ebon Chalice (the lowest value that passes)
offence.desc: Within 6" of the Triumph of Saint Katherine (Simulacrum of the Ebon Chalice): two Acts of Faith, two Miracle dice of the lowest value that passes.

offence.name: Blood of Martyrs — Below Starting Strength (+1 Hit)
offence.desc: +1 to the Hit roll while the unit is below its Starting Strength. Pick one of these two state toggles.

offence.name: Blood of Martyrs — Below Half-strength (+1 Hit, +1 Wound)
offence.desc: +1 to the Hit roll and +1 to the Wound roll while the unit is Below Half-strength.

offence.name: Fervent Purgation — +1 Strength (ranged, target within 6")
offence.desc: +1 Strength to ranged attacks vs a unit within 6". Toggle with the half-range Condition when within 6". (Weapons also gain [ASSAULT] — movement utility, no damage change.)

offence.name: Righteous Purpose — Righteous unit (+1 WS and BS)
offence.desc: Righteous BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD / CELESTIAN INSIDIANTS / CELESTIAN SACRESANTS / PARAGON WARSUITS units improve their WS and BS by 1. Toggle when the unit is Righteous (up to 3 units per turn).

offence.name: Absolution in Battle (vow) — PENITENT melee +1 A, +1 S (charged)
offence.desc: While the Absolution in Battle Vow is active, PENITENT units that made a Charge move add 1 to the Attacks and Strength of their melee weapons. Toggle with the Charged condition.

offence.name: Holy Quest — CELESTIAN +1 WS and BS
offence.desc: Friendly CELESTIAN units' attacks have +1 Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill (always on in this detachment).

defence.name: Miracle dice on a saving throw
defence.desc: Acts of Faith: one saving throw is a Miracle dice, an unmodified roll of its value (AP still applies). Choose the value; it is spent against the weapon that deals the most damage where it passes.

defence.name: Value: 6
defence.desc: The Miracle dice shows a 6.

defence.name: Value: 5
defence.desc: The Miracle dice shows a 5.

defence.name: Value: 4
defence.desc: The Miracle dice shows a 4.

defence.name: Value: 3
defence.desc: The Miracle dice shows a 3.

defence.name: Simulacrum of the Ebon Chalice — two Acts of Faith (within 6" of the Triumph)
defence.desc: While a friendly Adepta Sororitas unit is within 6" of the Triumph of Saint Katherine, it can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase: two saving throws are Miracle dice of the chosen value.

defence.name: Miracle dice on a saving throw
defence.desc: Acts of Faith: one saving throw is substituted by a Miracle dice, an unmodified roll of its value (AP still applies), against the weapon that deals the most damage: a 6 on a single-model VEHICLE, MONSTER or CHARACTER, else a 3, 4 or 5 that is exactly the save needed.

offence.name: Mindhunger - re-roll Hits of 1 (vs CHARACTER)
offence.desc: LICTOR and NEUROLICTOR units re-roll Hit rolls of 1 against a CHARACTER unit. Toggle when the target is a CHARACTER.

offence.name: Hyper-adaptation: Swarming Instincts ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs INF/SWARM)
offence.desc: Attacks vs INFANTRY or SWARM units gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. One Hyper-adaptation active for the battle.

offence.name: Hyper-adaptation: Hyper-aggression ([LETHAL HITS] vs MON/VEH)
offence.desc: Attacks vs MONSTER or VEHICLE units gain [LETHAL HITS]. (Hive Predators = [PRECISION] vs CHARACTER on a crit — no math.)

offence.name: Enraged Behemoths — MONSTER +1 Hit (below Starting Strength)
offence.desc: A TYRANIDS MONSTER below its Starting Strength gets +1 to Hit. (Below Half-strength also +1 Wound — use the other toggle.)

offence.name: Enraged Behemoths — MONSTER +1 Hit + +1 Wound (Below Half-strength)
offence.desc: A TYRANIDS MONSTER Below Half-strength gets +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound.

offence.name: Synaptic Imperative: Goaded to Slaughter (+1 Hit melee)
offence.desc: While within Synapse Range, +1 to Hit with melee attacks. One Synaptic Imperative active per battle round (the 5+ invuln Imperative is a defensive toggle).

offence.name: Surprise Assault — re-roll Hit of 1
offence.desc: TYRANIDS attacks re-roll a Hit roll of 1 (always on in this detachment).

defence.name: Encephalic Diffusion — −1 to hit (attacker within 6")
defence.desc: While the attacking unit is within 6" of the Maleceptor, subtract 1 from its Hit rolls. Toggle when the attacker is inside the 6" aura.

defence.name: Encephalic Diffusion — and −1 to wound (attacker Below Half-strength)
defence.desc: If that attacking unit is also Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from its Wound rolls as well. Needs the −1 to hit toggle on (same 6" condition).

defence.name: Synaptic Imperative: Synaptic Augmentation (5+ invulnerable)
defence.desc: While within Synapse Range, models have a 5+ invulnerable save. One Synaptic Imperative active per battle round.

defence.name: Leader-beasts — 5+ invulnerable (TYRANID WARRIORS)
defence.desc: TYRANID WARRIORS, Tyranid Prime with Lash Whip and WINGED TYRANID PRIME units have a 5+ invulnerable save (always on in this detachment).

offence.name: Fury of Titan — Deep Struck this turn (re-roll Hit 1 + Wound 1)
offence.desc: A unit set up via Deep Strike re-rolls a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1 until end of turn. Toggle on the turn it arrives.

offence.name: Channelled Force — Psychic melee [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
offence.desc: On a passed Leadership test when selected to fight, [PSYCHIC] melee weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Pick one Channelled Force effect.

offence.name: Channelled Force — Psychic melee [LETHAL HITS]
offence.desc: On a passed Leadership test when selected to fight, [PSYCHIC] melee weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].

offence.name: Hallowed Ground — re-roll Hit of 1
offence.desc: Re-roll a Hit roll of 1 (ranged vs a visible target, or in melee). Pick this or the full re-roll below.

offence.name: Hallowed Ground — full Hit re-roll (PURIFIER / within Hallowed Ground)
offence.desc: Full Hit re-roll if the unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD and/or wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground (your DZ, near a Purifier Squad, or contested NML/enemy DZ).

offence.name: The Stars Are Right — Staff of Tomorrow ×3 A and S, every wound Critical (once per battle)
offence.desc: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase: until the end of the phase, triple the Attacks and Strength of this model’s Staff of Tomorrow, and every successful Wound roll for its attacks scores a Critical Wound.

offence.name: Phaeron of the Stars - re-roll Hit & Wound of 1 (within 6" of the Silent King)
offence.desc: While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER units) is within 6" of the Silent King’s Szarekh model, its attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. Toggle when inside the aura.

offence.name: Power Matrix - re-roll Hits of 1 (CRYPTEK / CANOPTEK)
offence.desc: CRYPTEK and CANOPTEK units re-roll Hit rolls of 1. Use this toggle when the unit is NOT wholly within your Power Matrix.

offence.name: Power Matrix - re-roll all Hits (wholly within your Power Matrix)
offence.desc: While the CRYPTEK/CANOPTEK unit is wholly within your Power Matrix (your deployment zone always, plus any area whose objectives you half-control), re-roll the Hit roll instead of just 1s. Toggle when wholly inside.

offence.name: Awakened Dynasty — Led by a Character (+1 Hit)
offence.desc: While a NECRONS CHARACTER leads this unit, +1 to the Hit roll. Toggle on when a Character is attached.

offence.name: Starshatter Arsenal — Target on an objective (+1 Hit)
offence.desc: +1 to Hit vs a unit within range of an objective marker (NECRONS, excluding MONSTER). Toggle when the target holds/contests an objective. (Vehicle/Mounted ranged guns also gain [ASSAULT] — movement utility, no damage change.)

offence.name: Obeisance Phalanx — vs your marked target (+1 Wound)
offence.desc: NOBLE / LYCHGUARD / TRIARCH units get +1 to Wound against the one enemy unit you mark each Command phase. Toggle when firing at that unit.

offence.name: Annihilation Legion — vs closest target (+1 AP, ranged)
offence.desc: DESTROYER CULT ranged attacks vs the closest eligible target improve AP by 1. Toggle when the target is the closest enemy.

offence.name: Cursed Legion — Destroyer Cult +2 Strength
offence.desc: +2 Strength to weapons equipped by DESTROYER CULT models (always on).

offence.name: Cursed Legion — Frenzy: other Necrons +2 Strength
offence.desc: After a DESTROYER CULT unit destroys a unit / takes one below half (1/turn), other NECRONS weapons (excl. Destroyer Cult / Monster / Titanic) gain +2 Strength until end of turn. Toggle when triggered.

offence.name: Pantheon of Woe — Target unravelling (+1 AP)
offence.desc: A NECRONS MONSTER makes enemy units within 6" "unravelling": each attack vs an unravelling unit improves AP by 1. Toggle when the target is within 6" of a friendly Necrons Monster.

offence.name: Transdimensional Deployment — TOMB BLADES +1 Hit (ranged, ingress this turn)
offence.desc: When a friendly TOMB BLADES unit is selected to shoot, if it made an ingress move this turn, its ranged attacks have +1 to the Hit roll. Toggle on the turn it arrives.

offence.name: Cryptek Conclave — Cryptek: [ANTI-INFANTRY 3+]
